note: The 20-case test set for the triage prompt. Gold labels follow the house conventions stated in the lesson: a dated ask outranks a question; a question outranks an undated ask; a question the email itself answers is information; a receipt confirmation on an announcement is information; bulk mail is archive whatever it asks.
